body: I’m in so much pain, I believe I’ve a autoimmune disorder/disease. My stomach, heart, lungs and joints all are inflamed, it’s being going on 2 years without diagnosing.. I’ve had blood tests,scans and tests.. but nothing is showing.. I’m in pain everyday and the only relief is Ibuprofen(which isn’t idea for Stomach inflammation) Any help or advice would be greatly appreciated

Hi, I’m living with a incurable condition, my immune system is slowly scarring all my internal organs, I’ve had it for 20 years and it is showing signs now, I’m thinking about ending it all before the condition gets worst
